minutes.headline: Select Board and Assessors appointed Sarah Kammer to the vacant Board of Assessors seat until the May 2024 election.
minutes.summary: A joint meeting of the Select Board and Board of Assessors interviewed one applicant for the vacant assessor seat and appointed her by roll call. The board then voted to add two placeholder articles to the special town meeting warrant: one for vehicles funded from a special purpose stabilization fund, and one to amend the animal bylaw. The chair had dropped off, so only four Select Board members voted.

what_happened.line: A joint meeting of the Select Board and Board of Assessors appointed Sarah Kammer to the vacant assessor seat by unanimous roll call, until the May 2024 election.
The Select Board voted 4-0 to direct the town manager to place a special town meeting article on using the special purpose stabilization fund for three vehicles.
The board voted 4-0 to place an article on the special town meeting warrant revising the nuisance section of the animals bylaw.
Both articles are placeholders voted to meet a Monday warrant deadline, with their content to be discussed before town meeting.
A request for a rain date for the Oktoberfest was withdrawn, so the event stays on schedule for the Saturday.

why_it_matters: The assessors set the valuations that distribute the property tax levy, so the appointee will serve on that board until residents vote on the seat in May 2024.

The vehicle article would draw on the special purpose stabilization fund for vehicles earlier bought with ARPA money, and voters at special town meeting will be asked to approve or reject that spending; the board's vote only put it on the warrant.
watch_next: The Monday warrant deadline, and the final wording of the vehicle stabilization fund and animals bylaw articles before special town meeting.
The May 2024 town election, when the assessor seat goes to the voters.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. reconciliation.summary: The records agree on the Assessors appointment and on the two warrant-article requests, and neither records transfers or dollar figures. The tallies and the Oktoberfest and deadline discussion appear only in ours, and the two warrant votes may differ in substance: the official names the November special town meeting and Article 1 Dog Control, ours the nuisance section. Our attendee list also treats Mr Jeffries and Michael Ray as two people, though the official lists one Michael-Ray Jeffreys.
